description: This file defines a CatalogProvider class for managing book catalog state, including loading and filtering books, in a Flutter application.

classes.name: CatalogProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider that manages a list of books, loading state, and category filtering in a Flutter app.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Loads the initial list of books from the API and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: filterByCategory
methods.description: Filters books based on a category, fetching data from the API and updating the state.
